body: High-density economy seating is a game of inches, and in 2026 the airlines pushing it furthest are split between narrowbody and widebody extremes. The vast majority of low-cost and ultra-low-cost carriers use the Boeing 737 and the Airbus A320 families, which are designed to seat six abreast in economy, so with narrowbodies the density factor is essentially a matter of seat pitch. The widebody Airbus A350 is where the layout can change: low-cost carriers can squeeze a tenth seat into each row, while a few airlines in Asia still configure their Boeing 777s nine-abreast and Japan Airlines is now alone in still having Boeing 787 Dreamliners configured eight-abreast in economy.

Ryanair shows how far pitch can be cut. The airline fits more rows into its Boeing 737 MAX 8s by reducing seat pitch to around 28-29 inches and omitting premium seats, but on the MAX 8 it is possible to pack in more low-pitch seats than the aircraft is legally certified to carry because of exit limits. The workaround was Boeing developing the MAX 8-200, which adds more exits so the aircraft can still evacuate in 90 seconds in an emergency. In theory the aircraft can carry 210 people including crew, though EASA does not certify that many, and Ryanair configures them with 197 seats plus six to eight crew members.

On the A350, Airbus developed a new production standard that added four inches of internal cabin width, from 5.61 meters to 5.71 meters, making ten-abreast seating easier. Only three airlines configure their A350-1000s ten-abreast, and two of them use the old production standard. French bee and Air Caraïbes, sister leisure carriers under Groupe Dubreuil, are the only two airlines to configure the old production standard A350-1000s ten-abreast, and also the only two to configure the shorter A350-900s ten-abreast. French bee configures its four A350-900s with 411 seats in total, including 376 economy seats and 35 premium economy seats, against a maximum certified seating density of 440, while Air Caraibes configures its three A350-900s with 389 seats. French bee's A350-1000s carry 480 seats in total, of which 440 are economy and 40 are premium economy, making them the only examples configured at their maximum certified 480 seating configuration; Air Caraibes's four A350-1000s carry 429 seats in total.

Philippine Airlines stands out as the only flag carrier to configure its A350-1000s ten-abreast, using the new production standard, with its first aircraft delivered in late 2025 and seat widths of around 17 inches, against around 16-16.7 inches at French bee and Air Caraibes. The new standard also optimized the cabin layout, fitting more rows and adding an extra 30 or so seats in typical configurations. The densest A330s belong to Cebu Pacific, whose eight A330-900s are configured with 459 seats in an all-economy, nine-abreast layout, close to the certified maximum of up to 465 seats. Other exceptionally dense A330s include Lion Air with up to 440 seats and AirAsia's A330-300s with up to 367 seats, against 281 seats in three classes on Delta Air Lines' A330-900s. The Boeing 777X, by contrast, is designed as a premium airliner: Boeing is cutting down the exits on the 777-9, and its maximum passenger certification is estimated at only around 475, below the 777-300ER's 550, even though the stretched aircraft is expected to carry an extra 34 passengers in a typical configuration.
en.summary: From Ryanair's 197-seat Boeing 737 MAX 8-200s to French bee's 480-seat Airbus A350-1000s and Cebu Pacific's 459-seat A330neos, the world's densest economy cabins in 2026 squeeze the most seats out of every inch of cabin width and pitch.
en.title: The airlines with the world's most high-density economy cabins in 2026

body: 高密度經濟艙是一場以英寸計較的遊戲，2026年走得最遠的航空公司分屬窄體與廣體兩個極端。絕大多數低成本與超低成本航空公司使用波音737與空中巴士A320系列，經濟艙設計為每排6座，因此窄體機的密度關鍵在於座椅間距。廣體空中巴士A350則能改變布局：低成本航空公司可以每排多塞進第10個座位；亞洲仍有少數航空公司的波音777維持每排9座，而日本航空是目前唯一仍將波音787夢幻客機經濟艙設為每排8座的航空公司。

瑞安航空展現了座椅間距能壓到多低：該公司將波音737 MAX 8的座椅間距縮減至約28至29英寸、不設高級座位以塞進更多排座椅；但在MAX 8上，受限於逃生出口數量，低間距座椅的數量可能超過飛機合法載客認證上限。解法是波音為其開發MAX 8-200，增加逃生出口，使飛機能在90秒內完成緊急疏散。理論上該機可載210人（含機組員），但歐洲航空安全局並未認證這麼多；瑞安航空實際配置為197個座位加上6至8名機組員。

在A350方面，空中巴士開發了新的生產標準，機艙內部寬度增加4英寸，由5.61公尺增至5.71公尺，使每排10座的布局更容易實現。目前僅3家航空公司將A350-1000設為每排10座，其中2家使用舊生產標準。法國蜜蜂航空（French bee）與加勒比航空（Air Caraïbes）同屬杜布勒伊集團（Groupe Dubreuil）旗下的休閒航空公司，是僅有的2家將舊生產標準A350-1000設為每排10座的航空公司，也是僅有的2家將較短的A350-900設為每排10座的航空公司。法國蜜蜂航空4架A350-900共配置411個座位，包括376個經濟艙座位與35個豪華經濟艙座位，最高認證載客量為440座；加勒比航空3架A350-900共389個座位。法國蜜蜂航空的A350-1000共480個座位，其中440個經濟艙、40個豪華經濟艙，是唯一達到最高認證480座配置的例子；加勒比航空4架A350-1000共429個座位。

菲律賓航空則是唯一將A350-1000設為每排10座的傳統全服務航空公司，採用新生產標準，首架於2025年底交付，座椅寬度約17英寸，相較法國蜜蜂航空與加勒比航空的約16至16.7英寸更寬。新標準也優化了客艙布局，可多排座椅，典型配置約增加30個座位。密度最高的A330屬於宿霧太平洋航空：其8架A330-900全經濟艙布局共459個座位、每排9座，接近最高認證465座。其他密度極高的A330包括獅子航空最多440座、亞洲航空A330-300最多367座；相較之下，達美航空的A330-900為三艙等281座。波音777X則反其道而行，定位為高級客機：波音正在減少777-9的逃生出口數量，最高載客認證估計僅約475人，低於777-300ER的550人，儘管加長機身在典型配置下預計可多載34名乘客。
zh.summary: 從瑞安航空197座的波音737 MAX 8-200，到法國蜜蜂航空480座的空中巴士A350-1000與宿霧太平洋航空459座的A330neo，2026年全球密度最高的經濟艙在客艙寬度與座椅間距的每一英寸裡榨出最多座位。
zh.title: 2026年全球最高密度經濟艙：A350十排座與459座A330neo
